news.title: Chelsea Women vs Roma: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足对阵罗马：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea's UEFA Women's Champions League campaign continues when Italian side Roma come to west London. The Blues remain unbeaten in continental competition this season after two matches of the league phase and will be looking to make it back-to-back home wins in the Champions League as European football returns to the top of the agenda in midweek. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Roma, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Roma takes place on Wednesday 28 October 2026 at Plough Lane, with kick-off scheduled for 5.45pm UK time. Tickets for the game remain on sale. If you can't make it to Plough Lane, then you can watch the match live on Disney+. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Roma Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea are yet to lose in this season's Champions League and have a 100 per cent record on home soil at Plough Lane. We opened our league phase campaign in west London with a 1-0 win over Austria Vienna, Wieke Kaptein getting the only goal of the game, before a goalless draw away at eight-time European champions Lyon last time out. Our opponents, on the other hand, come to these shores looking for their first win of the league phase, although they have won three in a row domestically in Serie A. In Europe, Roma started with a 0-0 draw against Leuven away in Belgium, but were then humbled by a 6-0 home defeat to Barcelona. Chelsea are hosting Roma in the league phase of the Champions League for the second season in a row, although last term's meeting at Stamford Bridge was the first-ever between these two sides. On that occasion it was a one-sided affair, with Kaptein, Johanna Rytting Kaneryd, Sjoeke Nusken, Maika Hamano and Lucy Bronze all getting on the scoresheet, after an own goal had given us the lead, in a 6-0 victory for the Blues. That was the only game Roma have ever played against English opposition, while Chelsea are unbeaten in five games against Italian teams, with fours wins and one draw, plus 15 goals scored to one against. We have never conceded at home to a Serie A side.
news.body_zh: 当意大利球队罗马来到伦敦西部时，切尔西的欧洲女子冠军联赛比赛仍在继续。在联赛阶段的两场比赛之后，蓝军本赛季在大陆比赛中保持不败，并且随着欧洲足球在周中重返议程的首要位置，他们将寻求在冠军联赛中实现背靠背主场胜利。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看切尔西女足对阵罗马的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵罗马的比赛将于 2026 年 10 月 28 日星期三在 Plough Lane 举行，开球时间定于英国时间下午 5 点 45 分。比赛门票仍在销售中。如果您无法前往 Plough Lane，则可以在 Disney+ 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵罗马比赛中心提供。您还可以在 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上关注切尔西女足的社交媒体频道。切尔西在本赛季的欧冠联赛中尚未失利，并且在主场普劳巷保持着 100% 的战绩。我们在伦敦西部以 1-0 战胜奥地利维也纳拉开了联赛阶段的序幕，维克·卡普坦 (Wieke Kaptein) 攻入了全场唯一进球，上一次客场0-0战平八届欧洲冠军里昂。另一方面，我们的对手来到这里寻求联赛阶段的首场胜利，尽管他们在意甲联赛中已经取得了国内三连胜。在欧洲，罗马在比利时客场0-0战平鲁汶，但随后又在主场0-6惨败给巴塞罗那。切尔西连续第二个赛季在欧冠联赛阶段主场迎战罗马，尽管上赛季在斯坦福桥的交锋是两队的首次交锋。那次比赛是一场一边倒的比赛，在乌龙球帮助我们取得领先之后，卡普坦、约翰娜·雷廷·卡内里德、斯乔克·努斯肯、麦卡·滨野和露西·布朗泽都取得了进球，蓝军以 6-0 获胜。这是罗马队对阵英格兰球队的唯一一场比赛，而切尔西队在对阵意大利球队的五场比赛中保持不败，四胜一平，而且对阵意大利球队打进了15个进球。我们从未在主场输给意甲球队。

news.title: Chizaram Ezenwata signs new deal
news.title_zh: 奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔签署新合同
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Cobham Next Gen forward Chizaram Ezenwata has signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2029. Ezenwata joined Chelsea during his Under-15 year and quickly made an impression with his constant threat in attacking areas. He has been developed through the age groups of the Chelsea Academy, with his sharp footwork and clinical finishing among the standout features. Last season for the Under-18s, he enjoyed an outstanding season in front of goal, scoring 15 goals and providing seven assists in 21 matches. Now a regular in the CNG squad, Ezenwata made his Premier League 2 debut in 2024/25 against Manchester City. He continued to make an impact in the division, as well as for the Under-18s in 2025/26, which led to him being nominated for the Under-18 Premier League Player of the Season. His form has led to international recognition with England’s Young Lions. He represented England at the Under-17 World Cup in Qatar and scored a hat-trick in an 8-1 group-stage victory over Haiti. Most recently, he represented England during the September and October international window. The 18-year-old scored three goals in as many games for England Under-19s.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布科巴姆下一代前锋奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizaram Ezenwata) 签署了一份新合同，让他至少在俱乐部效力到 2029 年 6 月。埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 在 U-15 赛季加入切尔西，并凭借在进攻领域持续的威胁很快给人留下了深刻的印象。他在切尔西青训营的各个年龄段中都得到了培养，其出色的脚法和冷静的射门能力是他的突出特点。上赛季，他在U-18队中表现出色，在21场比赛中打进15球并送出7次助攻。现在，埃森瓦塔是 CNG 队的主力球员，他在 2024/25 赛季对阵曼城的比赛中首次亮相英超 2 场比赛。他继续在联赛以及 2025/26 赛季的 U-18 联赛中发挥影响力，这使他被提名为本赛季 U-18 英超联赛最佳球员。他的表现赢得了英格兰幼狮队的国际认可。他代表英格兰队参加了卡塔尔举行的U-17世界杯，并在小组赛8-1战胜海地队的比赛中上演帽子戏法。最近，他代表英格兰队参加了九月和十月的国际比赛。这位 18 岁的球员在英格兰 U-19 队的比赛中打进了 3 个进球。

news.title: Bronze on Baltimore’s ‘magic’ and team desire proving decisive
news.title_zh: 巴尔的摩的“魔力”和团队渴望具有决定性作用，获得铜牌
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze was quick to praise Sandy Baltimore after the French international's starring role in Sunday’s Women’s Super League win at Crystal Palace, but believes it is Chelsea Women’s strength in depth across the pitch which is proving key this season. Despite difficult conditions as Storm Boelo battered Britain over the weekend, the Blues made their dominance tell by the final whistle, fighting back after falling behind against the run of play in the first half. Melvine Malard smashed in the equaliser from range, before heading us in front following tricky footwork by Baltimore. The three points were made safe late on, when Malard was brought down in the box, allowing Baltimore to make it 3-1 from the penalty spot and send Chelsea top of the WSL table. ‘It was bit of a tornado at times,’ admitted Bronze. ‘The conditions were a bit windy to say the least, but no excuses there. I think the quality and the desire as a team shined through in the end. ‘Palace put up a good fight, especially in the first half when the wind was with them. I don't think we're too happy with conceding from a corner, but just doing really well to get back into the game. ‘Obviously Sandy Baltimore came into the game and did what Sandy Baltimore does, her magic. I'm just happy with the result and the three points.’ Baltimore’s introduction came as one of two half-time substitutions by Sonia Bompastor as the Blues looked to chase the game and her impact was clear, particularly when beating a trio of defenders to tee up Malard to give us the lead for the first time in the game. ‘I thought that was one of the best moments, when we scored the second for Malard,’ Bronze continued. ‘I wasn't expecting it at all really. ‘It was made by having Sandy one v one – but she was actually one v three then – something that we all know that she's so good at. Give her the ball and she'll find a way to get it in the box and get around players. ‘But we have so many players that can come on and change a game. Erin [Cuthbert] as well has come on at half-time. We had new faces coming onto the pitch as well with Manaka [Matsukubo] and Giulia [Dragoni]. ‘So we're in a good place as a squad. We've got players available and we've been able to lift ourselves and have moments when we need them.’ For all the individual brilliance on display as we fought back to beat Crystal Palace, it is that depth of talent in the Chelsea squad which Bronze feels is proving to be most important during our strong start to the current campaign. ‘There's definitely a level of consistency that's followed through our games this year and I think last season, particularly in the second half of the season, we struggled a little bit with that. ‘It’s something that we've worked on really hard over pre-season. We have so much consistency across the pitch, no matter who's playing. We're really strong across every position, having two or three players, and just having that consistent mentality in every training session, every game, no matter who's playing or who's in the squad. ‘I think that's something that has changed a lot and that's the thing that will set us apart from some of the other teams this season.’ After six games played in the 2026/27 WSL, the Blues remain unbeaten and have won our last five. That sequence has taken us clear of Manchester City at the top of the table on goal difference after our rivals drew with Manchester United later on Sunday. ‘It's still quite early on in the season,’ Bronze concluded. ‘We've not even hit the halfway point. We just want to keep collecting our points, keep the pressure on ourselves more than anything. ‘The season's very long and it can change. Different teams will start to do well, momentum changes, but for us it's just about keeping the points coming so that we're always in contention to win the league.’
news.body_zh: 在周日女足超级联赛战胜水晶宫的比赛中法国国脚桑迪·巴尔的摩发挥出色后，露西·布朗兹很快就称赞了这位法国国脚，但她相信切尔西女足在球场上的深度实力才是本赛季的关键。尽管周末风暴博埃洛袭击了英国，但蓝军在上半场落后的情况下发起反击，在终场哨响时证明了自己的统治地位。梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 远距离扳平比分，随后巴尔的摩 (Baltimore) 巧妙的脚法为我们带来头球。最后，马拉德在禁区内被放倒，球队保全三分，巴尔的摩通过点球将比分改写为 3-1，切尔西在 WSL 积分榜上排名第一。 “有时有点像龙卷风，”布隆兹承认。 “至少可以说，天气有点大风，但没有任何借口。我认为作为一个团队的品质和愿望最终得到了体现。 “宫殿队打得很好，特别是在上半场，当他们顺风的时候。我不认为我们对角球失球感到太高兴，但我们做得很好，重新回到了比赛中。 “显然，桑迪·巴尔的摩进入了比赛，并做了桑迪·巴尔的摩所做的事情，她的魔力。我对结果和三分感到满意​​。”巴尔的摩的上场是索尼娅·邦帕斯特两次半场换人之一，蓝军希望追上比赛，她的影响力很明显，特别是在击败三名后卫为马拉德上球，让我们在比赛中第一次领先时。 “当我们为马拉德攻入第二球时，我认为那是最好的时刻之一，”布朗兹继续说道。 “我真的没想到会这样。 “这是由桑迪一对一制作的——但当时她实际上是一对三——我们都知道她非常擅长这一点。把球交给她，她就会找到一种方法将球送入禁区并绕过球员。 “但是我们有很多球员可以上场并改变比赛。艾琳（库斯伯特）也在中场休息时登场。我们也有新面孔出现在球场上，包括 Manaka [Matsukubo] 和 Giulia [Dragoni]。 “所以我们作为一支球队处于一个很好的位置。我们有球员可以上场，我们能够振作起来，在我们需要他们的时候度过。”尽管我们在反击水晶宫的过程中展现出了个人的才华，但布朗泽认为，在我们本赛季的强劲开局中，切尔西队的天赋深度被证明是最重要的。 “今年我们的比赛肯定有一定程度的稳定性，我认为上赛季，特别是在赛季后半段，我们在这方面遇到了一些困难。 `这是我们在季前赛中非常努力的事情。无论谁在比赛，我们在球场上都有很强的稳定性。我们在每个位置上都非常强大，拥有两到三名球员，并且在每次训练、每场比赛中都保持一致的心态，无论谁在比赛或谁在队中。 “我认为这已经发生了很大的变化，这将使我们与本赛季其他一些球队区分开来。”在 2026/27 WSL 进行六场比赛后，蓝军保持不败，并赢得了最后五场比赛。在周日晚些时候我们的对手战平曼联后，这一顺序让我们以净胜球优势超越了积分榜榜首的曼城。 “现在还处于赛季初期，”布隆兹总结道。 “我们甚至还没有达到一半。我们只是想继续收集积分，给自己施加压力比什么都重要。 “这个赛季很长，而且可能会发生变化。不同的球队会开始表现出色，势头会发生变化，但对我们来说，这只是为了保持积分，这样我们就能一直争夺联赛冠军。

news.body_en: Supporters on the Chelsea Official App have chosen their star performer in our 3-1 Women’s Super League success against Crystal Palace. The Blues had to battle from behind after going in at the break 1-0 down in blustery conditions in south London. Melvine Malard turned the game on its head with two goals, the first a blockbuster from distance, and the French forward then won a penalty that her compatriot Sandy Baltimore converted to make sure of the points. And it was Malard that you chose as our Star of the Match on the Chelsea Official App. She received 56 per cent of the votes cast, twice as many as Baltimore who earned 28 per cent.
news.body_zh: 切尔西官方应用程序上的支持者选出了他们在女足超级联赛 3-1 战胜水晶宫的比赛中的明星球员。蓝军在伦敦南部狂风大作的天气下，在中场休息时0-1落后，不得不从后面发起反击。梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 攻入两粒进球，扭转了比赛的局面，第一个进球是远距离进球，法国前锋随后赢得了点球，她的同胞桑迪·巴尔的摩 (Sandy Baltimore) 罚进了点球，确保了积分。您在切尔西官方应用程序上选择了马拉德作为我们的比赛之星。她获得了 56% 的选票，是巴尔的摩 (28%) 的两倍。

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Decisive domestic action and European nights
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：决定性的国内比赛和欧洲之夜
news.body_en: A Carabao Cup trip to Anfield, European fixtures for Cobham Next Gen and Chelsea Women, and a Premier League meeting with Manchester United headline a busy seven days for the Blues. Here is everything to look out for at Chelsea this week… We begin the week by looking back at Chelsea Women's WSL victory at Crystal Palace, with highlights and reaction from Sonia Bompastor, Melvine Malard, Lexi Potter and Lucy Bronze. Attention will then turn to a packed week ahead, with both senior teams preparing for important fixtures in league and cup competitions. There will be a double helping of pre-match press conferences on Tuesday as both our head coaches look forward to midweek action. Xabi Alonso will face the media ahead of Chelsea's Carabao Cup fourth-round tie away at Liverpool, with the Blues looking to book our place in the next round of the competition. Sonia Bompastor will also speak to the media at 3pm, previewing Chelsea Women's UEFA Women's Champions League league-phase meeting with Roma. The Blues will be aiming to make home advantage count as European football returns to London. Both press conferences will be available to watch on the Chelsea Official App and website, with the latest news and key updates available across our official channels. Cobham Next Gen’s UEFA Youth League campaign begins with a trip to Estonia to play Flora Tallinn in the first leg of our round two tie. Kick-off at the Lillekula Stadium is at 5pm, with the game being shown live on CFC+. It is also a European night for Chelsea Women as Roma visit the Cherry Red Records Stadium for a UEFA Women's Champions League encounter. Kick-off is at 5.45pm, and supporters can follow all the build-up, team news and live updates in our Chelsea Women vs Roma Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. We will also bring you the latest reaction and post-match coverage after the final whistle. Later in the evening, the men's team travel to Merseyside for a Carabao Cup clash with Liverpool. The tie at Anfield kicks off at 8pm, as Alonso's side look to progress in a competition that has provided plenty of memorable moments throughout Chelsea's history. The match will be broadcast live on ITV and Sky Sports in the UK. Supporters can also follow the action with minute-by-minute updates and live commentary in our Liverpool vs Chelsea Match Centre. Our focus turns to the weekend as preparations continue at Cobham. Following Wednesday's cup action, we will bring you the latest from both senior squads as the men's team prepare for Manchester United's visit to Stamford Bridge and Chelsea Women get ready for another London derby. There will also be a chance to catch up on the best of the action from our midweek fixtures, including highlights and reaction from Anfield and Chelsea Women's European encounter with Roma. Both head coaches will return to the press conference room as the weekend build-up gathers pace. Alonso will preview Saturday's Premier League meeting with Manchester United, while Bompastor will address the media at 3pm ahead of Sunday's WSL trip to Charlton Athletic. We will bring you the latest team news, the managers' thoughts and all the key talking points from both press conferences on the Chelsea Official App and website. The men's team take centre stage at Stamford Bridge as Manchester United visit for a Premier League encounter. Kick-off is at 12.30pm, with the Blues looking to bounce back in the league after the defeat to Tottenham ended our winning run. Supporters can follow all the build-up, team news and live action in our Chelsea vs Manchester United Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. We will provide minute-by-minute updates, live commentary and post-match reaction, alongside the best photographs and highlights from the Bridge. Earlier on Saturday, there is Academy action as Chelsea Under-18s travel to face West Ham United in the Under-18 Premier League. Kick-off is at 11am and supporters who have subscribed to CFC+ can watch the game live on our channels. We round off the week with another London derby as Chelsea Women travel to The Valley to take on Charlton Athletic in the Women's Super League. Bompastor's side kick off at 2.30pm, looking to build on their midweek European outing with a strong domestic performance against the newly-promoted hosts. The match will be shown live on BBC Two in the UK, while our Charlton Athletic vs Chelsea Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website will provide all the latest team news, live updates and reaction. We will also bring you the best of the action from Saturday's meeting with Manchester United and our Under-18s' trip to West Ham, ensuring you can catch up on everything happening across the club as another busy week comes to a close.

news.title: Melvine Malard on half-time wake-up call and love for Baltimore
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）中场休息时的警钟和对巴尔的摩的热爱
news.body_en: Melvine Malard described the striker’s instinct that saw her fire in a brace in our 3-1 win against Crystal Palace on Sunday, but also explained how the team needed a jolt at half-time to spark the comeback. The Eagles took the lead from a corner after 20 minutes, which meant we trailed at half-time for the first time this season. It took just five minutes after the restart for Malard to net her first of the afternoon and then she headed in from second-half substitute Sandy Baltimore’s cross 25 minutes later. The number nine then won a penalty in the final stages of the match, which Baltimore scored to complete the 3-1 victory. With the three points successfully in the bag, Malard explained how the team reacted in the dressing room at the interval. ‘It was so good to win today because it was a hard game with the wind,’ she explained. ‘But the team could keep going and put the energy into this game. ‘We said “wake up” at half time because it wasn’t a very good start to the game, but we know our quality; we know the way we needed to play to win the game. When we came back out in the second half, we showed that quality.’ Malard shot wide of the target right before she scored from 25 yards out, and she explained how that missed opportunity spurred her on to shoot from distance. ‘I was really in the action before when I missed, and so I knew my touch was good,’ she said. ‘I told myself to shoot and that’s what I did. I am in a good place. This is a seriously good team, and we have good staff.’ Malard paid tribute to Baltimore for a superb second-half display after the pair combined on both the second and third goals against Palace. ‘I love her,’ the striker beamed. ‘She has a lot of quality to go 1-v-1, and as a striker, you only need to go in the box, and she can give you the ball. She showed that today when she came in to help the team. ‘We will take the energy we put in today to the Roma game on Wednesday. We scored three goals today, so that is good. We will keep going to score the goals.’
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德描述了这位前锋在周日 3-1 战胜水晶宫的比赛中梅开二度的直觉，同时也解释了球队如何需要在半场休息时振作起来，以引发逆转。 20分钟后老鹰队通过角球取得领先，这意味着我们本赛季第一次在半场落后。比赛重新开始后仅五分钟，马拉德就攻入了下午的第一个进球，25 分钟后，她接到下半场替补桑迪·巴尔的摩的传中头球破门。随后，9号球员在比赛最后阶段获得点球，巴尔的摩队最终以3-1获胜。成功拿下三分后，马拉德在中场休息时解释了球队在更衣室的反应。 “今天获胜真是太好了，因为这是一场艰难的比赛，风很大，”她解释道。 “但是球队可以继续前进，并将精力投入到这场比赛中。 “我们在中场休息时说‘醒来’，因为这不是一个很好的比赛开局，但我们知道我们的实力；我们知道我们需要采取什么方式来赢​​得比赛。当我们在下半场扳回一城时，我们展现出了这样的实力。”马拉德在 25 码外射门之前射门偏出目标，她解释了这次错失的机会如何促使她进行远射。 “之前当我失手的时候，我真的很投入，所以我知道我的手感很好，”她说。 “我告诉自己要开枪，我就这么做了。我处于一个好地方。这是一支非常优秀的球队，我们有优秀的员工。”在对阵水晶宫队的第二个和第三个进球后，马拉德对巴尔的摩下半场的出色表现表示敬意。 “我爱她，”前锋微笑着说。 “她有很强的一对一能力，作为一名前锋，你只需要进入禁区，她就能把球传给你。今天当她进来帮助球队时，她就证明了这一点。 `我们将把今天投入的精力带到周三对阵罗马的比赛中。今天我们进了三个球，这很好。我们将继续进球。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on Malard 'banger' and second-half turnaround
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特谈马拉德的“猛击”和下半场的逆转
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained how the weather made things difficult for Chelsea away at Crystal Palace on Sunday, but hailed the quality of French duo Melvine Malard and Sandy Baltimore for our second-half turnaround. The Blues went in at the break 1-0 down after the home side netted from a corner, but a brace from Malard plus a late penalty from substitute Baltimore secured a 3-1 win despite the initial setback. Our head coach explained exactly how we reversed the deficit in tricky circumstances and gave insight into what she said at half-time to galvanise the side. ‘The weather was not helpful today,’ she said. ‘Especially for a team like us who like to play on the ground, it didn't help. We probably didn't create as much as I would have liked to in the first half. ‘The second half was a better performance. We played more with the wind, which helped a little bit as well. The quality of the players who came in was good again, and they brought the impact we needed to win the game. ‘We needed to stay confident in these moments. It's really important to stay calm, even if the result is not in our hands and the weather is not helpful. I knew in the second half we had enough quality to create and to score some goals. ‘The message was around adjusting some of the defensive aspects a little but also giving the players a lot of confidence with the ball. I wanted us to keep trying, because I knew we would have opportunities, and in those moments we were clinical.’ Malard would’ve scored a hat-trick had her third goal not been ruled offside on Sunday afternoon, and it was the number nine that won the penalty on 88 minutes. Baltimore created the assist for Malard’s second and converted the spot-kick at the end of the game, leaving Bompastor full of praise for her compatriots. ‘The French players showed up today, and it was really needed,’ the head coach continued. ‘I'm happy for them, especially Sandy. She hasn't had a lot of minutes recently, but that was the best answer she could give to me. Her performance was really good. ‘When you play a team that is sitting more in the low block, she brings a lot of quality on crosses, but also on the ball, and she can beat her opponent one-on-one. That was a big help today. ‘I wasn't expecting Melvine to score from distance like that. It's a banger, as you say here! She has the ability to create those goals. She's an important player for us and I'm glad for her that she scored a really difficult goal. She could have scored an easy one just before. It makes things even better for her, and scoring like that is always good for her confidence.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了周日客场对阵水晶宫的比赛中天气如何给切尔西造成了困难，但她对法国二人组梅尔文·马拉德和桑迪·巴尔的摩在下半场扭转局面的表现表示赞赏。中场休息时，主队角球破门，蓝军以 1-0 落后，但马拉德梅开二度，再加上替补出场的巴尔的摩在最后时刻的点球，尽管最初遭遇挫折，但蓝军还是以 3-1 获胜。我们的主教练准确地解释了我们如何在棘手的情况下逆转比分，并深入分析了她在半场时所说的话，以激励球队。 “今天的天气不太好，”她说。 “特别是对于像我们这样喜欢在地面上比赛的球队来说，这没有帮助。上半场我们可能没有创造出我想要的那么多。 ‘下半场表现更好。我们更多地利用风，这也有一点帮助。上场球员的素质再次出色，他们为我们带来了赢得比赛所需的影响。 “在这些时刻我们需要保持信心。保持冷静非常重要，即使结果不在我们手中并且天气也无济于事。我知道下半场我们有足够的实力来创造机会并取得一些进球。 “传达的信息是对一些防守方面进行一些调整，但同时也让球员对球充满信心。我希望我们继续努力，因为我知道我们会有机会，在那些时刻我们都很冷静。如果周日下午马拉德的第三个进球没有被判越位，她本可以上演帽子戏法，而正是第 9 号球员在第 88 分钟赢得了点球。巴尔的摩队为马拉德送出第二次助攻，并在比赛结束时主罚点球，让邦帕斯特对她的同胞们赞不绝口。 “法国球员今天出现了，这确实是需要的，”主教练继续说道。 “我为他们感到高兴，尤其是桑迪。她最近没有太多时间，但这是她能给我的最好答案。她的表演真的很好。 “当你对阵一支更多地坐在低​​位的球队时，她在传中和控球方面都带来了很大的质量，她可以一对一地击败对手。这对今天来说是一个很大的帮助。 “我没想到梅尔文能像那样远距离得分。正如你在这里所说的，这是一个香肠！她有能力创造这些目标。她对我们来说是一位重要的球员，我为她感到高兴，因为她打进了一个非常困难的进球。之前她本可以轻松得分。这让她的情况变得更好，这样的得分总是有利于她的信心。”

news.title: Match report: Crystal Palace 1-3 Chelsea Women
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：水晶宫 1-3 切尔西女足
news.body_en: A brace from Melvine Malard and a penalty scored by Sandy Baltimore ensured Chelsea recovered from a subpar first half to secure a 3-1 victory away at Crystal Palace. The sun came out on Sunday for our trip to south London after Saturday's torrential rain, but the howling wind wasn't conducive to stroking the ball around on the floor. For all of Chelsea's good work in the opening quarter-of-an-hour, it was the home side who took the lead when Molly Bartrip bundled the ball home from a corner after 20 minutes. Sonia Bompastor's team talk must've had an impact as the Blues emerged with a renewed focus after the break as Malard levelled the scores on 50 minutes with a stunning effort from the edge of the box. The match once again became tight as Palace attempted to preserve the point, but some determined work from substitute Baltimore on the left wing gave her the space to serve up an opportunity on a plate for Malard to head in her second of the afternoon. Baltimore then got herself on the scoresheet when she converted a late penalty after Malard was fouled in the box, ensuring we finished the day on a positive note after our first-half struggles. Bompastor made two alterations to her starting line-up ahead of this fixture, rotating Keira Walsh and Lauren James out of the side in place of Sjoeke Nusken and Maika Hamano. Meanwhile, Manaka Matsukubo made the squad for the first time since joining Chelsea in the summer from North Carolina Courage. The game began with the Blues pushing forward to make an immediate impact, with Alyssa Thompson causing problems for the home side down the left-hand channel and Ellie Carpenter linking up well with central striker Malard on the right. Our first real opportunity of the match came in the 14th minute, when Hamano saw her shot palmed away by the goalkeeper before Malard's shot was cleared off the line by the Palace defence. The strong winds in Sutton were always going to play a part in this contest, and made set-pieces more dangerous for both sides. When Palace swung in their second corner of the match, defender Bartrip popped up at the back post to steer the ball through the resulting melee and into the bottom corner of the net. Chelsea attempted to hit back through a Nusken power drive from inside the penalty area, but Pauline Peyraud-Magnin was able to quickly get low to snuff out the danger. Bompastor made two changes at the break, exchanging Hamano and Thompson for Erin Cuthbert and Baltimore. We showed our attacking intent when Malard went close within minutes of the restart, and it was the French international who got us back on level terms shortly afterwards. Receiving the ball 25 yards from goal from a Katie McCabe throw-in, Malard found herself in space and unleashed a stunning strike that fizzed past a helpless Peyraud-Magnin. But determined Palace were keen to fight back, and there was a let-off when former Blues striker Bethany England got herself into a good position to shoot but blazed her attempt over the bar. Our second goal of the afternoon saw Malard net her brace, but the chance was created solely by Baltimore. Driving towards the box, she sped between two Palace defenders before evading the challenge of a third and making it to the by-line to deliver a looping ball straight to the head of Malard, who wasted no time in nodding the ball home. Our noses were finally in front with 15 minutes to play, and Malard could've had her hat-trick soon afterwards but was denied by the offside flag after taking a slight touch on a brilliant ball in from McCabe. As the home side began to tire, Nusken was unlucky not to get on the scoresheet when she hit the woodwork, and with 88 minutes on the clock the French duo were decisive once again when we were awarded a penalty. Malard won the spot-kick when she was fouled inside the box, and after the number nine received some brief treatment, the ball was passed to Baltimore. The substitute stepped up and converted, securing the points after an excellent second-half display. There was to be one more positive before the final whistle, too, as Matsukubo was handed her Chelsea debut when she was introduced on 90 minutes. This was another resilient performance from the Blues, as we recorded our sixth win from seven WSL games so far this season. We go top of the WSL table, pending Manchester City's result later on. We return to Women's Champions League action when we take on Roma at Plough Lane at 5.45pm on Wednesday. news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德的梅开二度和桑迪·巴尔的摩的点球帮助切尔西从上半场的低迷状态中恢复过来，客场3-1战胜水晶宫。周六的暴雨过后，周日太阳出来了，我们前往伦敦南部旅行，但呼啸的风不利于在地板上抚摸球。尽管切尔西在开场一刻钟表现出色，但 20 分钟后莫莉·巴特里普 (Molly Bartrip) 从角球将球射入球门，主队取得了领先。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的团队讲话一定产生了影响，蓝军在中场休息后重新集中注意力，马拉德在禁区边缘的一脚惊人射门在第 50 分钟扳平了比分。比赛再次变得胶着，水晶宫试图保住这一分，但替补上场的巴尔的摩在左翼的顽强拼搏为她提供了空间，为马拉德在下午的第二场比赛中头球破门。马拉德在禁区内被犯规后，巴尔的摩队在最后时刻罚进点球，取得了进球，确保我们在上半场的挣扎之后以积极的姿态结束这一天。博姆帕斯特在这场比赛之前对首发阵容进行了两次调整，将凯拉·沃尔什和劳伦·詹姆斯轮换出首发阵容，代替舍克·努斯肯和麦卡·滨野。与此同时，自今年夏天从北卡罗来纳勇气队加盟切尔西以来，松久保真中首次入选大名单。比赛一开始，蓝军就立即发起进攻，阿丽莎·汤普森在左路给主队制造了麻烦，而埃莉·卡彭特则与右侧的中锋马拉德配合得很好。我们本场比赛的第一个真正的机会出现在第 14 分钟，当时滨野看到她的射门被门将挡出，随后马拉德的射门被水晶宫后卫挡出了底线。萨顿的强风总是会在这场比赛中发挥作用，并使双方的定位球变得更加危险。当水晶宫开出第二个角球时，后卫巴特里普突然出现在后门柱处，引导球穿过由此产生的混战，进入球网下角。切尔西试图通过禁区内的努斯肯强力反击进行反击，但宝琳·佩罗-马格宁迅速压低身位，化解了危险。邦帕斯托在中场休息时做出了两次换人，将哈野野和汤普森换成了艾琳·库斯伯特和巴尔的摩。当马拉德在比赛重新开始后几分钟内逼近时，我们展现了我们的进攻意图，不久之后正是这位法国国脚让我们扳平了比分。马拉德在距离球门 25 码处接到凯蒂·麦凯布的界外球后，发现自己处于空位，并射出一脚惊人的射门，飞过了无助的佩罗-马宁。但意志坚定的水晶宫渴望反击，前蓝军前锋贝瑟尼·英格兰找到了一个良好的射门位置，但射门高出横梁，导致了一次失误。我们下午的第二个进球是马拉德梅开二度，但这个机会完全是由巴尔的摩创造的。她冲向禁区，在两名水晶宫后卫之间快速穿行，然后躲避了第三名后卫的挑战，并到达边线，将一记弧线球直接传到马拉德的头上，马拉德毫不犹豫地将球打进了球门。比赛还剩 15 分钟时，我们的比分终于领先，马拉德本可以很快上演帽子戏法，但在接住麦凯布的精彩传球后，被越位旗挡出。当主队开始疲倦时，努斯肯不幸击中门框而未能取得进球，在比赛还剩88分钟时，这对法国组合再次发挥了决定性作用，我们获得了点球。马拉德在禁区内被犯规，赢得了点球，9号球员经过短暂治疗后，球传给了巴尔的摩。下半场替补球员上场并完成转换，凭借出色的表现锁定了积分。终场哨响之前还有一个积极的事情，松久保在第 90 分钟上场时完成了切尔西的处子秀。这是蓝军的又一次坚韧表现，本赛季迄今为止，我们在七场 WSL 比赛中取得了第六场胜利。我们在 WSL 积分榜上名列前茅，等待曼城稍后的结果。周三下午 5 点 45 分，我们将回到女子冠军联赛的比赛中，我们将在 Plough Lane 迎战罗马。 切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、麦凯布、努斯肯（德拉戈尼 90）、波特、卡普坦（比弗-琼斯 69）、汤普森（巴尔的摩主队）、滨野（卡斯伯特主队）、马拉德（松久保 90）未上场替补：彭、布尔曼、拉斯、布朗得分手：马拉德 50、75、巴尔的摩 90 黄牌：卡普坦 44、麦凯布 44、铜牌 63 水晶宫：佩罗-马格宁、埃弗雷特（队长）、劳埃德-史密斯、英格兰、拉德（恩格 90+5）、布兰查德、拉金、戈尔迪、角田、斯瓦比（纳皮尔 90+5）、巴特里普未上场替补：亚内兹、夏普、霍瓦特、韦尔登、诺兰、霍普克罗夫特、奥布莱恩记分员：巴特里普 20 黄牌：布兰查德 44，拉德 70 裁判：爱丽丝·帕克

news.title: Lacroix: ‘We must show the reaction of a competitor’
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦：“我们必须展示竞争对手的反应”
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix is looking to our forthcoming games against Liverpool and Manchester United as an opportunity to put things right after our loss to Tottenham. The Blues were beaten 2-0 at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, putting an abrupt end to our promising recent results. However, there is a chance to hit back in the best way possible by defeating two longstanding rivals, starting with our Carabao Cup fourth round trip to Anfield in midweek. ‘It’s a big game for us,’ said Lacroix. ‘We want to go far in this competition and it’s good that we have a game like this now. We have to move on and work on some details to be stronger in certain moments and change some situations. ‘We have to show the reaction of a competitor. We want to show another face, we want to win there, and it’s going to be a big game.’ Lacroix also offered support to Mike Penders, whose own goal gave Tottenham the lead on his first Premier League start. Xabi Alonso has confirmed the Belgian will start at Anfield on Wednesday, and Lacroix explained how the group will offer support to Penders ahead of that trip. ‘He is a young goalkeeper and he has a lot of talent,’ said Lacroix. ‘He will learn from this. This can happen in football careers and in life, everyone makes mistakes, and we have to be with him and we are going to be with him. We are behind him. He will help us this season and now we have to help him.’
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦（Maxence Lacroix）将接下来对阵利物浦和曼联的比赛视为在输给托特纳姆热刺后扭转局面的机会。周六，蓝军在斯坦福桥被 2-0 击败，为我们近期的希望之战画上句号。然而，我们有机会以最好的方式进行反击，击败两个长期对手，从周中前往安菲尔德的卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛开始。 “这对我们来说是一场重要的比赛，”拉克鲁瓦说。 “我们希望在这场比赛中走得更远，现在有这样的比赛真是太好了。我们必须继续前进，在一些细节上努力，以便在某些时刻变得更强并改变某些情况。 “我们必须展示竞争对手的反应。我们想要展示另一张面孔，我们想要在那里获胜，这将是一场重要的比赛。”拉克鲁瓦还向迈克·潘德斯表示支持，他的乌龙球让托特纳姆热刺队在他的第一次英超首发中取得了领先。哈维·阿隆索已经确认比利时人将于周三在安菲尔德首发，拉克鲁瓦解释了该团队将如何在那次旅行之前为彭德斯提供支持。 “他是一名年轻的门将，很有天赋，”拉克鲁瓦说。 ‘他将从中吸取教训。这种情况可能发生在足球生涯和生活中，每个人都会犯错误，我们必须和他在一起，我们也会和他在一起。我们在他身后。他将在这个赛季帮助我们，现在我们必须帮助他。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Crystal Palace
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵水晶宫的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made two changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match away at Crystal Palace. The Blues are coming off a 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge last weekend and now face another test in the WSL against the newly-promoted Eagles. Bompastor has switched Keira Walsh for Sjoeke Nusken, while Maika Hamano – who scored a wonder goal against Spurs – comes in for Lauren James. Lexi Potter starts against the team where she spent two seasons on loan. She helped Palace earn promotion to the WSL in 2023/24 and returned to spend a full campaign in the top flight the following year. And after completing her recovery from injury and scoring a hat-trick for the Under-18s last weekend, summer signing Manaka Matsukubo is named on the bench for the first time this season. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan, McCabe, Nusken, Potter, Kaptein, Thompson, Hamano, Malard Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Buurman, Las, Dragoni, Baltimore, Brown, Cuthbert, Matsukubo, Beever-Jones
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在客场对阵水晶宫的女足超级联赛中对切尔西队做出了两项调整。蓝军上周末在斯坦福桥以 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺队，现在又要在 WSL 中面对升班马老鹰队的另一场考验。邦帕斯特用凯拉·沃尔什换下了斯乔克·努斯肯，而在对阵热刺的比赛中打进精彩进球的麦卡·滨野则换下了劳伦·詹姆斯。莱克西·波特在对阵她租借了两个赛季的球队时首发。她帮助水晶宫在 2023/24 赛季晋升到 WSL，并于次年重返顶级联赛并度过了一个完整的赛季。上周末从伤病中恢复过来并为 U-18 队上演帽子戏法后，夏季新援松久保真中本赛季首次进入替补席。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、麦凯布、努斯肯、波特、卡普坦、汤普森、滨野、马拉德切尔西替补：彭、布尔曼、拉斯、德拉戈尼、巴尔的摩、布朗、库斯伯特、松久保、比弗-琼斯

news.title: Caicedo: 'Everybody knows what we need to improve'
news.title_zh: 凯塞多：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么”
news.body_en: Moises Caicedo didn’t search for excuses in his post-match media duties after our defeat to Tottenham Hotspur. And his message was clear: ‘Everybody knows what we need to improve’. The Blues entered yesterday’s game at Stamford Bridge after back-to-back top-flight wins that had seen Bournemouth and then Everton convincingly beaten. We had also not tasted defeat on home soil this season. As Xabi Alonso accepted after the game, we were not at our best across the 90 minutes. Yet we did create chances. Cole Palmer, Jordan Henderson, Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto all tested Antonin Kinsky in the opening period. Yet in a tight second half, Tottenham broke the deadlock by forcing an own goal from Mike Penders following a corner. Mathys Tel then netted late on to seal the win, with the Blues down to ten men after Cole Palmer was sent off. Caicedo, who wore the captain’s armband, was naturally disappointed with the result and accepted the Blues must learn from the painful defeat. He said: ‘We need to be focused during the whole game because if you switch off for one second, you get punished. ‘We need to learn from this because we need to stop this from happening and we need to maintain the clean sheet for the whole game. ‘It was a tough one, but we need to keep going because there are more games in front of us and we want to do better.’ The Ecuadorian midfielder added: ‘Everybody knows what we need to improve. We are going to think about this game because we need to be up there in the table.  We need to learn from this and for sure we are going to be up there [at the end of the season].’ For Caicedo, the game saw his third start in succession after overcoming an early-season injury. The 24-year-old was impressive in the middle of the pitch, winning a game-high four interceptions and making two tackles. ‘I tried to do my best and help the team and for sure I’m feeling better game by game,’ he explained. ‘This one was a tough game but I want to keep doing well and improving what I need to improve because I want to be someone that helps the team in every moment.’
news.body_zh: 在我们输给托特纳姆热刺队后，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多并没有在他的赛后媒体职责中寻找借口。他的信息很明确：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么”。蓝军在连续两场顶级联赛胜利后进入了昨天在斯坦福桥的比赛，其中伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿都被令人信服地击败。本赛季我们在主场也没有尝到失败的滋味。正如哈维·阿隆索赛后承认的那样，我们在 90 分钟内并没有处于最佳状态。但我们确实创造了机会。科尔·帕尔默、乔丹·亨德森、摩根·罗杰斯和佩德罗·内托都在开场阶段考验了安东尼·金斯基。然而，在紧张的下半场，托特纳姆热刺队在角球后迫使迈克·彭德斯自摆乌龙，打破了僵局。马蒂斯·特尔随后在最后时刻进球锁定胜局，在科尔·帕尔默被罚下场后，蓝军的人数只剩下十人。戴上队长袖标的凯塞多自然对结果感到失望，并认为蓝军必须从惨痛的失败中吸取教训。他说：“我们需要在整场比赛中保持专注，因为如果你停顿一秒钟，你就会受到惩罚。 “我们需要从中吸取教训，因为我们需要阻止这种情况发生，我们需要保持整场比赛不失球。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，但我们需要继续前进，因为我们面前还有更多比赛，我们想要做得更好。”这位厄瓜多尔中场补充道：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么。”我们会考虑这场比赛，因为我们需要在积分榜上名列前茅。  我们需要从中吸取教训，并且确信我们将在赛季末达到目标。”对于凯塞多来说，这场比赛是他在克服赛季初伤病后连续第三次首发。这位24岁的球员在中场的表现令人印象深刻，赢得了全场最高的四次拦截并完成了两次铲球。 “我尽力做到最好，帮助球队，当然我每一场比赛都感觉更好，”他解释道。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，但我想继续表现出色，并改进我需要改进的地方，因为我想成为每时每刻都能帮助球队的人。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on his confidence in Mike Penders and Liverpool decision
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对迈克·彭德斯和利物浦的决定充满信心
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has emphasised his Chelsea team ‘win and lose together’ and reaffirmed his confidence in Mike Penders, who the Blues manager confirmed will start against Liverpool in the Carabao Cup. The Belgian goalkeeper made his first Premier League start in yesterday’s game against Tottenham Hotspur and produced impressive first-half stops to deny Omar Marmoush and Mathys Tel. Unfortunately, in the second period, an own goal from Penders under pressure from Jan Paul van Hecke enabled Tottenham to take the lead. It was one of the visitors doubled late on to claim a rare win at Stamford Bridge. Alonso stressed the importance of everyone learning and improving following the defeat, including our 21-year-old goalkeeper. ‘It’s part of the business; you need to deal with mistakes and we keep confidence in Mike and he will be in goal against Liverpool,' the Blues manager said. ‘We win and we lose together and it’s part of the job to deal with mistakes, myself as well as everyone. ‘We support Mike and Geo (Quenda) as well, the guys starting their first [Premier League] games. He will want to prove he can do better - and we also have to show that.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索强调他的切尔西队“赢和输在一起”，并重申了他对迈克·潘德斯的信心，蓝军主教练确认他将在卡拉宝杯对阵利物浦的比赛中首发。这位比利时门将在昨天对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中首次在英超联赛中首发，并在上半场做出了令人印象深刻的扑救，挡出了奥马尔·马尔穆什和马蒂斯·特尔的射门。不幸的是，第二节，潘德斯在范赫克的压力下打进乌龙球，帮助热刺取得领先。这是其中一支客队在最后时刻加倍，在斯坦福桥取得了一场罕见的胜利。阿隆索强调了失败后每个人学习和进步的重要性，包括我们 21 岁的门将。 “这是业务的一部分；你需要处理错误，我们对迈克保持信心，他将在对阵利物浦的比赛中进球，”蓝军主教练说道。 “我们一起赢，一起输，处理错误是工作的一部分，无论是我自己还是每个人。 “我们也支持迈克和吉奥（奎恩达），他们开始了他们的第一场[英超]比赛。他想要证明自己可以做得更好——我们也必须证明这一点。

news.title: Premier League 2 report: Cobham Next Gen 2-2 Liverpool
news.title_zh: 英超联赛 2 报告：科巴姆下一代 2-2 利物浦
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen were forced to settle for a point in Premier League 2 this afternoon after a 2-2 draw against Liverpool at Kingsmeadow. Harrison McMahon broke the deadlock inside two minutes with a powerful finish into the bottom corner. Sol Gordon then added to the scoreline midway through the opening period with a first-time strike beyond Harvey Davies to put the Blues in control. Minutes later, though, we were pegged back as Will Wright made it 2-1. Although we went in ahead at the break, Liverpool scored another early in the second half through a Jayden Danns free-kick. Both sides pushed for a late winner, but the spoils were shared. Chelsea set the tone immediately, scoring within two minutes through McMahon. Chizaram Ezenwata picked up the ball centrally and turned before playing a pass into McMahon’s path, and the midfielder made no mistake with his low-driven strike across goal. Ezenwata, who claimed the assist for the opener, caused the Liverpool’s backline constant problems, getting on the ball in deep areas and driving forwards. He wasn’t far away from doubling our lead when he found half a yard on Reds defender Talla Ndiaye, but his effort went just wide. Our speed constantly caused issues for the visitors' defence, with Mathis Eboue and Gordon enjoying plenty of success down the flanks. It was the latter who doubled our advantage, finishing a well-worked move. Ezenwata held the ball up well and forced his marker to bring him down. That enabled Kendry Paez to emerge with the ball and burst forward. Just as Ecuadorian looked like he was going to shoot, he instead chopped inside onto his right foot and selflessly passed to Gordon, who dispatched a fine finish past Davies. Five minutes after Gordon scored, Wright pulled one back for the visitors, capitalising on their only meaningful chance of the half. After the break, Liverpool pulled themselves back level with Danns converting from a free-kick. He placed his strike into the bottom corner, beyond the outstretched glove of Freddy Bernal. Liverpool continued to put us under pressure, with Prince Cisse hitting the post and Oliver O'Connor missing a clear-cut chance. We pushed for a late winner but were ultimately forced to settle for a point. After six games, this draw leaves us on 13 points in Premier League 2 and in second position. The league leaders are ahead via goal difference with a game in hand. Cobham Next Gen are kickstart their UEFA Youth League campaign on Wednesday 28 October, when we face Estonian side Flora Tallinn at the Lillekula Stadium. The game gets underway at 5pm BST and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 切尔西科巴姆下一代队今天下午在金斯梅多 2-2 战平利物浦后，被迫在英超第二轮比赛中获得一分。哈里森·麦克马洪在两分钟内就以一记强力射门打破了僵局。随后，索尔·戈登在开场中段首次进球，超越哈维·戴维斯，帮助蓝军掌控局势。然而几分钟后，我们被追平，威尔·赖特将比分改写为 2-1。尽管我们在中场休息时取得领先，但利物浦在下半场一开始就通过杰登·丹斯的任意球再次进球。双方都力争最后的胜利，但战利品是共享的。切尔西立即定下基调，两分钟内就通过麦克马洪进球。奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔（Chizaram Ezenwata）在中路接球转身，然后将球传给麦克马洪（McMahon）的路径，这位中场球员的低射门没有失误。首场比赛助攻的埃森瓦塔给利物浦的后防线带来了持续的麻烦，他在后场接球并向前推进。当他发现红军后卫塔拉·恩迪亚耶半码处时，距离将我们的领先优势扩大一倍不远了，但他的射门稍稍偏出。我们的速度不断给客队的防守带来问题，马蒂斯·埃布和戈登在侧翼取得了很多成功。正是后者将我们的优势扩大了一倍，完成了一场精心策划的行动。埃森瓦塔（Ezenwata）很好地控住了球，并迫使他的盯防者将他放倒。这使得肯德利·佩兹能够持球并向前冲锋。正当厄瓜多尔人看上去要射门时，他右脚内切，无私地传给戈登，戈登以一记漂亮的射门越过了戴维斯。戈登进球五分钟后，赖特为客队扳回一球，利用了他们半场唯一一次有意义的机会。中场休息后，丹斯任意球破门，利物浦将比分扳平。他将球射入底角，超出了弗雷迪·伯纳尔伸出的手套。利物浦继续给我们带来压力，西塞王子击中门柱，奥利弗·奥康纳错失了一次绝佳的机会。我们力争最后获胜，但最终被迫只得一分。六场比赛过后，这场平局让我们在英超联赛第二名中积 13 分，排名第二。联赛领头羊在少赛一场的情况下以净胜球优势领先。科巴姆下一代队将于 10 月 28 日星期三开始他们的欧洲青年联赛，届时我们将在利勒库拉体育场迎战爱沙尼亚球队弗洛拉塔林。比赛将于英国夏令时下午 5 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（3-4-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔；阿尔菲·奥斯本、贾斯汀·奥萨吉、塔约·苏布洛耶；哈里森·麦克马洪、雷吉·沃森、肯德利·佩兹（哈里森·贝托尼 81）、利奥·布莱克；索尔·戈登、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、马蒂斯·埃布埃（里奥·卡多佐 65）未上场替补：杰克·奥斯汀、莱利·埃博、丹特·维特、卡尔文·迪亚基特、易卜拉欣·拉巴杰进球者：哈里森·麦克马洪 2、索尔·戈登 20 黄牌：贾斯汀·奥萨吉 63、阿尔菲·奥斯本 73 利物浦（4-3-3）：哈维·戴维斯；西塞王子、卢卡斯·皮特、Wellity Lucky、塔拉·恩迪亚耶；本·特鲁曼（约瑟夫·厄普顿 69 分钟）、迈克尔·拉菲（中）、约书亚·兰比（丹尼尔·奥纳努加 69 分钟）；奥利弗·奥康纳、杰登·丹斯（约瑟夫·布拉德肖 69’）、威尔·赖特未上场替补：贝利·霍尔、阿尔文·艾曼、瑞安·考利、帕特里克·法卡斯进球球员：威尔·赖特 25、杰登·丹斯

news.title: Xabi Alonso on Tottenham defeat: 'We all take the blame'
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈托特纳姆热刺失利：“我们都承担责任”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was disappointed with the performance and result against Tottenham Hotspur and accepted his Chelsea side 'can do better' after succumbing to a two-goal defeat at Stamford Bridge. During a rain-soaked 90 minutes in SW6, both sides created goalscoring opportunities across the 90 minutes. Cole Palmer forced Antonin Kinsky into a good first-half save, and Jordan Henderson, Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto were also denied by the Tottenham goalkeeper. Mike Penders made good stops of his own, first to deny Omar Marmoush and then Mathys Tel. However, with 13 minutes remaining, Tottenham forced a Penders own goal from a corner and, after Palmer was dismissed for two yellow cards, Tel struck late on to seal a rare Spurs' victory at Stamford Bridge. Alonso was honest in his post-match assessment, acknowledging the performance was not at the level the Blues had displayed in our back-to-back wins over Bournemouth and Everton. ‘We all take the blame for the result and for the performance,' he said. 'Today we were not at our best. I felt that in the second half, the game was even and could have gone either way. Once we conceded that first goal, and then with the red card, it was difficult.' The Blues manager continued: 'In the second half, it was tight, with some half-chances for them and half-chances for us. It was about taking a moment and once we conceded the first goal, it conceded everything. Then, when we wanted to have a reaction, we got the red card. Then it went the other way. 'We can do better. It's one to reflect after this big game that it was against a good opponent. And the performance, it's one to improve.' The Blues' preparation for the game was disrupted with Joao Pedro sustaining an injury in training on the eve of Tottenham's visit. And Alonso said the absence of the Brazilian forward did mean a late change to the game plan was needed. He said: 'We had to take many decisions in a short time. What we had been working on in the week, you need to be flexible and adapt. So it changed the idea we had a little bit, but this is football, and it can happen. 'It’s no secret that with Joao we are better, but it’s not about talking about the players missing. It’s about the players who were on the pitch. We can do better and we have to be critical of ourselves.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对对阵托特纳姆热刺队的表现和结果感到失望，并在斯坦福桥两球失利后承认他的切尔西队“可以做得更好”。在SW6的90分钟大雨中，双方都创造了进球机会。科尔·帕尔默迫使安东尼·金斯基上半场做出精彩扑救，乔丹·亨德森、摩根·罗杰斯和佩德罗·内托也被热刺门将挡出。迈克·彭德斯 (Mike Penders) 也做出了出色的防守，首先阻挡了奥马尔·马穆什 (Omar Marmoush)，然后阻挡了马蒂斯·特尔 (Mathys Tel)。然而，在比赛还剩13分钟时，托特纳姆热刺在角球中迫使彭德斯自摆乌龙，帕尔默因两张黄牌被罚下场后，特尔在最后时刻的进球帮助热刺在斯坦福桥取得了一场罕见的胜利。阿隆索在赛后评估中很诚实，他承认蓝军的表现没有达到我们在背靠背战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿时所表现出的水平。 “我们都为结果和表现承担责任，”他说。 “今天我们没有处于最佳状态。我觉得下半场比赛是势均力敌，双方都有可能获胜。一旦我们丢了第一个球，然后又吃到了红牌，那就很难了。”蓝军主教练继续说道：“下半场比赛很紧张，他们的机会各有一半，我们的机会也各有一半。这需要一点时间，一旦我们丢了第一个球，它就丢了一切。然后，当我们想要做出反应时，我们得到了红牌。然后事情又走向了另一条路。 '我们可以做得更好。在这场重要的比赛之后，我们要反思的是，这是对阵一个优秀的对手。性能也需要改进。”若奥·佩德罗在热刺造访前夕的训练中受伤，蓝军的比赛准备工作被打乱。阿隆索表示，巴西前锋的缺席确实意味着需要对比赛计划进行后期调整。他说：“我们必须在短时间内做出许多决定。我们这周一直在做的事情，你需要保持灵活性并适应。所以它稍微改变了我们的想法，但这就是足球，它是可能发生的。 “有了若奥，我们会变得更好，这已经不是什么秘密了，但这并不是在谈论球员的缺失。这是关于球场上的球员的。我们可以做得更好，但我们必须对自己进行批评。

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 0-2 Tottenham Hotspur
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 0-2 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: It proved a disappointing evening for the Blues at Stamford Bridge as we were beaten by Tottenham Hotspur. For much of the contest, little separated the two sides. In the opening period, Cole Palmer and Jordan Henderson forced Antonin Kinsky into good saves. Mike Penders, meanwhile, produced good stops to deny Omar Marmoush and Mathys Tel. The second period remained tight, but with 13 minutes to play, a Tottenham corner ended up in the Blues' goal via the hand of Penders, who was put under pressure by Jan Paul van Hecke. Palmer was then shown a red card after receiving two yellows inside ten minutes, and Tel netted late on for Tottenham to condemn the Blues to defeat. Xabi Alonso was forced to make two changes to his starting XI. Emi Martinez and Joao Pedro both missed out due to injuries –the latter sustaining an issue in training yesterday – and were replaced by Penders and Geovany Quenda. The opening 45 minutes were played in a downpour. It meant every touch had to be precise and every pass weighted perfectly. The Blues looked more threatening in the early stages and kept Tottenham at arm's length. Our first chance of note was fashioned as the game approached the quarter-hour mark. Pedro Neto started it as he won the ball near the corner flag and fed it to Morgan Rogers inside the box. The England international laid it first-time to Palmer, who whipped his shot to the far post from an acute angle. However, Antonin Kinsky saved well. As the half progressed, Spurs took a stranglehold of possession. Mohammed Kudus had the visitors' first shot of the evening – an attempt from inside the box that flew wide – before a good chance was created for Omar Marmoush from 10 yards. Penders reacted quickly to produce an excellent stop. The Belgian goalkeeper produced an even better save soon after, rushing out and diving at the feet of Mathys Tel to deny the forward's left-footed strike. Alonso's side responded to the Spurs' attempts. The first came following a mistake from Kinsky, which enabled Neto, Rogers and Palmer to exchange one-touch passes in the Tottenham penalty area and lay the ball to Henderson. The Blues midfielder attempted to guide his finish into the corner, but put it close enough to Kinsky to allow the goalkeeper to save. Rogers was next denied as he drove a left-footed strike at goal, but the offside flag was subsequently raised. Our final chance of the half fell to Neto, with a free-kick worked short to the Portuguese winger. He drove his shot to the near post, yet Kinsky got down to save and the game was goalless at the interval. The Blues have often made fast starts to second halves this season, but both sides nullified each other's threat in 15 minutes after the break. Much of the game was played in midfield, with attacks breaking down or being snuffed out. It wasn't until the hour mark that a shot was registered that threatened to break the deadlock. It came from Neto, who, after winning the ball and finding Palmer, reacted quickest to a rebound inside the area and drove a shot at Kinsky. The Tottenham stopper beat it behind for a corner. Our first change of the afternoon came soon after, with Marco Palestra coming on for Hato. The Italian dropped into a role on the left of our defence. Estevao's introduction followed; he replaced Quenda. Before the Brazilian's introduction came the game's biggest flashpoint. After Caicedo launched a counter-attack and was fouled in the process by van de Ven, a run from Palmer was halted by Mateus Fernandes falling and grabbing the ball. Several players came together, and three yellow cards followed, one of which went to Palmer. From the restart, we fashioned an opportunity as Palmer and Henderson combined to get Estevao in on goal from a tight angle. He fired at goal but into the side netting. With 13 minutes to play, and somewhat against the run of play, Tottenham went ahead. A corner was delivered into the Chelsea penalty area and van Hecke put Penders under pressure. The ball struck the hand of the Blues goalkeeper and deflected into our net despite Maxence Lacroix's efforts. Our task got harder as, three minutes later, Palmer caught Conor Gallagher in midfield and referee Chris Kavanagh deemed it worthy of a second yellow card, and a red followed. The game was effectively killed late on as a run and finish from Tel gave Tottenham a two-goal advantage in the closing stages, which they were able to see out to claim victory. The Blues are back in action on Wednesday evening as we take on Liverpool in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup. news.body_zh: 事实证明，蓝军在斯坦福桥度过了一个令人失望的夜晚，我们被托特纳姆热刺队击败。在比赛的大部分时间里，双方几乎没有分出胜负。开局阶段，科尔·帕尔默和乔丹·亨德森迫使安东尼·金斯基进行了精彩扑救。与此同时，迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders）做出了精彩的拦网，挡住了奥马尔·马穆什（Omar Marmoush）和马蒂斯·特尔（Mathys Tel）的进攻。第二节比赛形势依然胶着，但在比赛还剩 13 分钟时，托特纳姆热刺队的角球最终通过潘德斯的手射入蓝军球门，潘德斯受到扬·保罗·范赫克的压力。帕尔默在十分钟内吃到两张黄牌后被出示红牌，而特尔在最后时刻为热刺攻入一球，宣告蓝军惨败。哈维·阿隆索被迫对首发阵容做出两次调整。埃米·马丁内斯和若昂·佩德罗均因伤缺席——后者在昨天的训练中出现问题——并被彭德斯和乔瓦尼·昆达顶替。开场45分钟是在倾盆大雨中进行的。这意味着每次触球都必须精确，每次传球都必须完美。蓝军在比赛初期看起来更具威胁性，并与托特纳姆热刺保持一定的距离。当比赛临近一刻钟时，我们第一次获得关注的机会出现了。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto）在角旗附近赢得球并将球传给禁区内的摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）。这位英格兰国脚将球传给了帕尔默，帕尔默以锐角将球射向远门柱。然而，安东尼·金斯基保存得很好。随着上半场的进行，热刺牢牢掌握了控球权。穆罕默德·库杜斯 (Mohammed Kudus) 为客队打出了当晚的第一脚射门——一次从禁区内射门，但飞出了底线——随后奥马尔·马尔穆什 (Omar Marmoush) 在 10 码外创造了一个好机会。彭德斯反应迅速，完成了出色的停球。比利时门将很快做出了更好的扑救，冲出并扑到马蒂斯·特尔脚下，挡出了前锋的左脚射门。阿隆索的球队回应了马刺队的尝试。第一个进球发生在金斯基的失误之后，内托、罗杰斯和帕尔默在托特纳姆禁区内交换一脚传球，并将球传给了亨德森。蓝军中场试图将射门射入角球，但球距离金斯基足够近，让门将扑救。罗杰斯随后左脚射门被挡出，但越位旗随后被举起。我们上半场的最后一次机会落在了内托身上，葡萄牙边锋的任意球没能成功。他射门近门柱，但金斯基倒地扑救，中场休息时比赛没有进球。本赛季蓝军经常在下半场快速开局，但双方在中场休息后15分钟内就化解了对方的威胁。比赛的大部分时间都是在中场进行，进攻被破坏或被压制。直到一小时后，才有可能打破僵局的一枪。球来自内托，他在赢得球并找到帕尔默后，对禁区内的篮板反应最快，并向金斯基射门。托特纳姆热刺队的门将在后面抢得角球。下午的第一次换人很快就到来了，马科·帕莱斯特拉换下了哈托。意大利人在我们后防线的左边发挥了作用。接下来是埃斯特沃的介绍；他取代了昆达。在巴西人上场之前，比赛最大的亮点出现了。在凯塞多发起反击并被范德文犯规后，帕尔默的跑动被马特乌斯·费尔南德斯摔倒并抢断。几名球员凑在一起，三张黄牌随之而来，其中一张是帕尔默的。从比赛重新开始，我们创造了一次机会，帕尔默和亨德森联手从小角度帮助埃斯特沃射门。他向球门射门，但射入了边网。比赛还剩 13 分钟时，托特纳姆热刺队取得了领先，这在一定程度上违背了比赛的节奏。切尔西禁区开出角球，范赫克给彭德斯施压。尽管马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 奋力拼搏，但球还是击中了蓝军门将的手并偏入了我们的球网。我们的任务变得更加艰巨，三分钟后，帕尔默在中场抓住了康纳·加拉格尔，裁判克里斯·卡瓦纳认为值得第二张黄牌，随后出示了一张红牌。比赛在最后阶段被终结，特尔的跑动和射门让托特纳姆热刺队在最后阶段取得了两球的优势，最终他们赢得了胜利。 周三晚上，蓝军将重返赛场，我们将在卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛中迎战利物浦。切尔西：彭德斯； Acheampong、Lacroix、Colwill、Hato（Palestra 65）；凯塞多 (c)、亨德森； Neto (Welbeck 88), Palmer, Quenda (Estevao 72);罗杰斯 切尔西替补：沙曼-洛、古斯托、福法纳、巴科、尼科尔-贾祖利、拉维亚黄牌：帕尔默 71、内托 79、罗杰斯 90+1 被罚下：帕尔默 80 托特纳姆热刺：金斯基；格雷、范赫克、范德文、罗伯逊（佩德罗波罗 65）； Mateus Fernandes, Tonali; Kudus (Kulusevski 89)、Maddison (Gallagher 51)、Tel (Davies 89)；马穆什（索兰克 65）托特纳姆热刺替补：杜布拉夫卡、塞内西、奥卢塞西、威廉姆斯-巴内特进球者：彭德斯 77、电话 87 黄牌：加拉格尔 67、范德文 71、马特乌斯·费尔南德斯 72

news.title: Cesar Azpilicueta joins Chelsea Legends squad taking on Tottenham
news.body_en: On the day the current Chelsea team play Spurs, another of our Champions League-winning captains is confirmed for when Stamford Bridge hosts a clash between old rivals on Saturday 27 March. The Chelsea Legends versus Tottenham Legends match will take place on Easter Weekend and raise crucial funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities. Cesar Azpilicueta, the sixth-highest appearance-maker in our history who won every major trophy available to him while at Chelsea, joins another successful skipper, John Terry, plus Eden Hazard, Oscar and Chelsea Women's legendary captain Katie Chapman as the players announced so far. They will be stirring great memories when they return to Stamford Bridge next spring with more legends to be announced in the coming weeks. news.title: Alonso explains Joao Pedro absence against Tottenham
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has explained why Joao Pedro is not in the Chelsea squad for this afternoon’s game against Tottenham Hotspur – and emphasised the qualities Mike Penders and Geovany Quenda will bring on their full Premier League debuts. We are back at Stamford Bridge this afternoon for what the Blues manager expects to be an ‘intense game’ against our London rivals, whom we are aiming to defeat for an unprecedented seventh success in the Premier League. Alonso has made two changes to the team that started our win at Everton last weekend. One was expected as Penders replaces the injured Emi Martinez, who underwent jaw surgery after a nasty collision with Jarrad Branthwaite at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. The other is the absence of Joao Pedro, with Alonso explaining the Brazilian was ruled out of the contest yesterday. ‘He felt something yesterday in training,’ Alonso said. ‘At the moment, he has some fluid [around the injury], so we have to do some tests to see how big is the injury is. For sure, it’s a disappointment, but we need to carry on.’ Quenda is the man Alonso has opted to replace Joao Pedro with in the starting XI. It is the Portuguese winger’s first top-flight start in English football after his arrival in the summer. He has many qualities,’ Alonso said when asked about Quenda’s selection.’ He attacks the space well, is good with the ball, and is a threat. He’s been training well, and all the players will have their opportunities. Sometimes, they have to be more patient. Geo has been patient, and today it’s a big game to make his debut as a starter. 'We want to have mobility and to be fluid, so that we are not static and for sure with Geo we have those qualities.' Penders, meanwhile, starts in the Premier League for the first time, having made his debut off the bench against Everton last weekend. ‘I believe in every player we have and today it’s the first start in the PL for Mike,’ explained Alonso. ‘He showed last weekend against Everton that the can have a good impact. We need to deal with injuries and now he has a good chance, and we are fully confident.’ A big-game atmosphere is building at Stamford Bridge ahead of kick-off, and Alonso has highlighted the important role the Blues supporters play across the 90 minutes. 'It will be an intense game at a high tempo and high intensity on the pitch and in the stands. A proper derby. We expect an intense game with different moments for everything, with our qualities and the qualities of Tottenham. So it’s going to be very interesting.'

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Tottenham
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made two changes to his Chelsea side for this evening's Premier League meeting with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. After defeating Bournemouth and then Everton, the Blues are targeting a third consecutive top-flight win – and an unprecedented seventh in the Premier League over Spurs. One change to the Chelsea starting XI was always going to be required, with Emi Martinez sidelined after undergoing jaw surgery following our win at Everton. Mike Penders comes into the side for his first Premier League start, and Alonso has also made one further alteration. Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Levi Colwill and Jorrel Hato all continue in what is expected to be a back four, while Moises Caicedo captains the side and partners Jordan Henderson in midfield. Pedro Neto, who netted twice last time out, starts once more in an attack that also includes Cole Palmer, Geovany Quenda and Morgan Rogers. Joao Pedro is not in the match-day squad. news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: Chelsea 4-1 Ipswich Town
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：切尔西 4-1 伊普斯维奇
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s came from behind to secure an impressive 4-1 victory over Ipswich Town at Cobham in the Under-18 Premier League, with Jacob Dako scoring a brace and Jacob Hall and Heze Grimwade always in target. After dominating the opening exchanges, the Blues fell behind in the 17th minute as Joel Ladegbaye swept home following an Ipswich counter-attack. We reacted positively, pushing for the leveller and probing the Ipswich back line on various occasions. Unfortunately, we couldn't apply a finishing touch before the break and went into the half-time interval a goal behind. The Blues continued to push in the second period, and our efforts paid off in the 66th minute as Dako found the net. That broke Ipswich's resistance and Hall netted soon after to put us ahead. We held that advantage until the closing stages – and then extended it as Ipswich attempted to salvage a point. Dako completed his double before Grimwade netted an excellent free-kick in stoppage time to seal a 4-1 victory. The Blues controlled the opening 15 minutes, although we were unable to consistently threaten the visitors' goal. Jashayde Greenwood did force a save from Ipswich goalkeeper Edward Twyman and Dako fired over the crossbar. After 17 minutes, we were punished on the counter, with Callum Stewart playing the final pass across the face of goal to enable Ladegbaye to sweep home and make it 1-0. We had a chance to level almost immediately, as Twyman raced out to clear his lines and missed the ball. Grimwade chased and lunged towards the ball, aiming to poke it into an empty net, but Pedro Felicio was there first to spare the goalkeeper’s blushes. We continued to search for an equaliser throughout the rest of the half. Ibrahim Rabbaj came close as he drifted inside and received the ball, but his left-footed attempt went just wide of the far post. We remained a persistent threat down the right, and Isaac McGillvary played a give-and-go with Rabbaj before cutting a pass to Greenwood. The Blues striker’s first-time shot was just off target. Towards the end of the half, Isaac Badu fashioned a great opportunity to level. The Portuguese youth international wriggled through midfield and played the ball to Greenwood, who lined up the shot before opting to tee up Rabbaj instead. But his shot was blocked and remained a goal down at the break. After the interval, it was more of the same, with the Blues holding onto the ball for long spells. Dako had two good chances in quick succession but was unable to convert either. Substitute Gabriel Sambou created the first, as he crossed into the penalty area for Dako, but he didn’t get enough on his header to steer it goalwards. Moments later, Greenwood drove towards goal and shimmied inside before laying the ball off to the midfielder, whose shot was dragged just wide. He was eventually rewarded with a goal, though. Captain Dante Waite played the ball behind the Tractor Boys’ defence, and Dako was able to tuck his finish into the net for his fifth league goal of the campaign. The Blues were a lot more like ourselves after Dako’s goal and, after Sambou had came agonisingly with a shot cleared off the line by Felicio. we scored our second just four minutes later. Hall gave us the advantage as he quickest when Twyman spilled a Dako free kick to place the ball into the corner. Having taken the lead, the Blues were oozing with confidence in the latter stages, and we began getting far more shots on target. Ipswich showed more attacking intent once they had fallen behind, but our defence handled the onslaught superbly. Dako then completed his brace to make it 3-1 with a neat finish into the bottom corner. The visitors' best chance fell to Kyle Messenger, who seemed set to halve the deficit. Toby Bell’s initial save was very impressive but the ball fell into Messenger’s path; fortunately, Hall made a fantastic recovery run and block. Grimwade got in on the action with the final kick of the game, scoring from a set piece once again. The 16-year-old wrapped the free-kick into the top left corner to end the game in style. This victory means we remain top of the table on 21 points, having won seven matches and scoring 37 goals. The Blues also extended our perfect run to five games. Chelsea Under-18s are back on the road next week when we face West Ham United on Saturday 31 October. The game gets underway at 11am BST and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. 反击中破门得分。我们做出了积极的反应，在不同的场合推动扳平比分并探查伊普斯维奇的后防线。不幸的是，我们没能在中场休息前完成最后一击，以一球落后的方式进入中场休息。蓝军在第二节继续推进，我们的努力在第 66 分钟得到了回报，达科破门得分。这打破了伊普斯维奇的抵抗，霍尔很快就进球帮助我们取得领先。我们一直保持着这一优势，直到最后阶段，然后随着伊普斯维奇试图挽回一分，我们扩大了优势。达科完成梅开二度，格里姆韦德在补时阶段打进一脚精彩的任意球，帮助球队4-1获胜。蓝军控制了开场 15 分钟，尽管我们无法持续威胁客队的球门。贾沙德·格林伍德迫使伊普斯维奇门将爱德华·特威曼做出扑救，达科的射门高出横梁。第 17 分钟，我们在反击中受到惩罚，卡勒姆·斯图尔特 (Callum Stewart) 的最后一脚传球穿过球门，拉德巴耶 (Ladegbaye) 破门得分，1-0。我们几乎有机会立即扳平比分，但特威曼冲出去清理他的防线，却错过了球。格里姆韦德追赶皮球，打算将球射入空门，但佩德罗·费利西奥率先赶到，避免了守门员的脸红。我们在下半场余下的时间里继续寻找扳平比分的机会。易卜拉欣·拉巴伊 (Ibrahim Rabbaj) 内线接球时差点就到了，但他的左脚射门稍稍偏出远门柱。我们在右路仍然是一个持续的威胁，艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里（Isaac McGillvary）与拉巴杰（Rabbaj）进行了一次传球，然后将球传给了格林伍德（Greenwood）。蓝军前锋的第一次射门刚刚偏离目标。半场结束时，艾萨克·巴杜创造了一次扳平比分的绝佳机会。这位葡萄牙青年国脚在中场蠕动，将球传给格林伍德，格林伍德将球对准，然后选择为拉巴伊发球。但他的射门被封堵，在中场休息时仍落后一球。中场休息后，情况基本相同，蓝军长时间控球。达科连续两次获得好机会，但都未能转化。替补球员加布里埃尔·桑布 (Gabriel Sambou) 创造了第一个进球，他传中达科的禁区，但他的头球攻门不够，未能将球射向球门。过了一会儿，格林伍德冲向球门，在内线晃动，然后将球传给中场球员，后者的射门稍稍偏出。不过，他最终还是收获了进球。队长丹特·韦特（Dante Waite）在拖拉机男孩队的防守后面打球，达科（Dako）将球射入球网，这是他本赛季的第五个联赛进球。在达科进球之后，在桑布痛苦地射门被费利西奥挡出底线之后，蓝军更像我们自己了。仅仅四分钟后我们就取得了第二个进球。当特威曼传出达科任意球将球送入角球时，霍尔为我们带来了优势，因为他速度最快。取得领先后，蓝军在后期充满了信心，我们开始获得更多的射正机会。伊普斯维奇在落后时表现出了更多的进攻意图，但我们的防守很好地应对了进攻。达科随后完成梅开二度，将比分改写为3-1，并漂亮地射入底角。客队最好的机会落到了凯尔·梅辛杰身上，他似乎将把比分差距缩小一半。托比·贝尔（Toby Bell）最初的扑救令人印象深刻，但皮球落入了梅塞辛斯（Messenger）的路径中；幸运的是，霍尔做出了出色的恢复跑动和拦网。格里姆韦德在比赛最后一脚发挥出色，再次定位球得分。这位16岁的球员将任意球打入左上角，以优雅的方式结束了比赛。这场胜利意味着我们以 21 分继续排名榜首，赢得了 7 场比赛并攻入 37 个进球。蓝军还将我们的完美连胜延续到了五场比赛。切尔西 18 news.title: Alonso: We knew Lacroix's impact would be instant
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：我们知道拉克鲁瓦的影响会立竿见影
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes Maxence Lacroix’s leadership and competitive nature have helped the centre-back quickly become an important member of his Chelsea team. Lacroix joined the Blues in the summer from fellow Londoners Crystal Palace after returning from the FIFA World Cup, where he was part of the France squad that reached the semi-finals. The defender has needed little time to adjust to his new surroundings across the capital and has become a central figure in Alonso’s plans, featuring in all our league fixtures so far this season – and starting all but one. A massive game is up next for the Blues, as Tottenham Hotspur visit Stamford Bridge this evening for a London derby that always gets the blood pumping in SW6. And ahead of that game, our manager discussed Lacroix’s strong start to life at Chelsea. Alonso said: ‘Max has many good things, but two of them are that he's ready – we knew that his impact was going to be instant with his Premier League experience, being competitive – and he has a strong personality. ‘He has great leadership. He likes to communicate, to be loud, to be very active in the game, and that presence is very important. ‘With the players around him, we are connecting better with him, and he's doing much better. He's doing good now, lately playing with Levi [Colwill] and when he has played with Wes [Fofana]. ‘We are very happy with him and he's feeling good.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦的领导能力和竞争天性帮助这位中后卫迅速成为切尔西队的重要成员。拉克鲁瓦在世界杯归来后于今年夏天从伦敦同胞水晶宫加盟蓝军，他随法国队进入了半决赛。这名后卫几乎不需要时间来适应首都的新环境，并已成为阿隆索计划中的核心人物，在本赛季迄今为止的所有联赛比赛中都有出场，并且除了一场之外都首发。蓝军接下来将迎来一场重要的比赛，托特纳姆热刺今晚将造访斯坦福桥，参加一场在 SW6 中总是令人热血沸腾的伦敦德比。在那场比赛之前，我们的主教练讨论了拉克鲁瓦在切尔西的强劲开局。阿隆索说：“马克斯有很多优点，但其中有两点是他已经准备好了——我们知道他的影响力会随着他的英超经验和竞争力而立竿见影——而且他有很强的个性。” ‘他具有出色的领导能力。他喜欢交流，喜欢大声说话，在比赛中非常活跃，这种存在感非常重要。 “有了他身边的球员，我们与他的联系就更好了，他也做得更好了。他现在表现不错，最近和利维[科尔威尔]一起打球，还有和韦斯[福法纳]一起打球。 “我们对他感到非常满意，他感觉很好。” 不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限 - 立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Alonso on harnessing passion and energy of ‘electric’ derby atmosphere
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈如何利用“电动”德比氛围的激情和能量
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso expects Chelsea supporters to create an 'electric' atmosphere inside Stamford Bridge during today's game against Tottenham Hotspur, which he believes will show the Premier League at its very best. Few occasions get Stamford Bridge bouncing quite like the visit of London rivals Tottenham to SW6; it's one of the first fixtures Blues supporters look out for when the Premier League fixtures are released each season. This match will be no different, with Alonso's side going into tomorrow's game in good form after back-to-back wins over Bournemouth and Everton. We are also looking for a club-record seventh consecutive home league victory over Spurs. Alonso is set to experience the atmosphere of a Chelsea versus Tottenham derby for the first time as Blues manager. But he knows what to expect and hopes the energy provided by the crowd can help his players to victory. ‘We are expecting a good atmosphere,’ he said. ‘Electric, with good energy, knowing that in a derby this passion is really in the air in the stadium. ‘We need to use it in a proper way because this is all about those games when you feel that excitement is something that you need. You don't need extra motivation; that will come naturally because of the history of the derby and because this is a top game. ‘We need that connection with the crowd in good moments. There will be tough moments, but we need to pull together and play our game. For me, it's fundamental that we play our game on the pitch. ‘The players, they do their best, but when the crowd is playing the game, is living it, that's the good thing about the Premier League. I think the crowd plays the game as well. It's not that they just watch the game. ‘They have great influence. When I say that spontaneously some energy is created in this league, it's because they feel that moment that: “Yes, I like what I see” and it's a big boost for the team.’ However, the Chelsea manager is aware that such emotionally charged atmospheres also require the players on the pitch to keep a level head to balance the passion with maturity, admitting that managing such situations in the Premier League is always a challenge mentally, but especially on occasions such as this. ‘It is very difficult,’ added Alonso. ‘That's why I've mentioned a few times that to find total dominance, a game when you are in full control and that you have no problems like in other leagues, it's difficult to find that in the Premier League unless you have become a top, top team. ‘That's why you can't rest when you are 2-0 up, because you know that if you concede one, the energy is coming, and you need to control that momentum. You can have mental preparation, but you need composure to deal with those moments. ‘I think that even in the Everton first half, we were 0-0, but there were a few [challenging] moments – 10 minutes of corner, throw-in, corner, throw-in. To go through those moments and to say, “Be calm guys, we know what we have to do, we have prepared for this and the other momentum will come”, for me it's fundamental.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索希望切尔西球迷在今天对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中在斯坦福桥内营造出一种“激动人心”的氛围，他相信这将展现英超联赛的最佳状态。很少有机会能像伦敦死敌托特纳姆热刺队造访 SW6 那样让斯坦福桥球场焕发活力。这是每个赛季英超联赛赛程发布时蓝军球迷最先关注的比赛之一。这场比赛也不会有什么不同，阿隆索的球队在连续战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿后，将以良好的状态进入明天的比赛。我们还希望创造俱乐部主场联赛连续第七次战胜热刺的纪录。阿隆索将作为蓝军主教练首次体验切尔西对阵托特纳姆热刺德比的气氛。但他知道会发生什么，并希望观众提供的能量能够帮助他的球员取得胜利。 “我们期待着良好的气氛，”他说。 “充满活力，充满活力，知道在德比中体育场的空气中确实弥漫着这种激情。 “我们需要以正确的方式使用它，因为当你觉得兴奋是你需要的东西时，这都是关于那些游戏的。你不需要额外的动力；由于德比的历史以及这是一场顶级比赛，这会很自然地发生。 “在美好的时刻，我们需要与人群建立联系。会有艰难的时刻，但我们需要齐心协力，打好自己的比赛。对我来说，我们在球场上踢球是至关重要的。 “球员们竭尽全力，但当观众参与比赛、享受比赛时，这就是英超联赛的好处。我认为人群也玩这个游戏。并不是说他们只是看比赛。 ‘他们有很大的影响力。当我说这个联赛自发地产生了一些能量时，是因为他们在那一刻感觉到：“是的，我喜欢我所看到的”，这对球队来说是一个巨大的推动。然而，切尔西主教练意识到，这种情绪激动的气氛也需要球场上的球员保持冷静，平衡激情与成熟，他承认在英超联赛中处理这种情况始终是一个精神上的挑战，尤其是在这样的场合。 “这非常困难，”阿隆索补充道。 “这就是为什么我多次提到，要找到完全的统治力，一场你完全控制的比赛，并且你没有像其他联赛那样的问题，在英超联赛中很难找到这种统治力，除非你已经成为一支顶级球队。” “这就是为什么当你2-0领先时你不能休息，因为你知道如果你丢球，能量就会到来，你需要控制这种势头。你可以做好心理准备，但你需要冷静地应对这些时刻。 “我认为即使是在埃弗顿上半场，我们还是0-0，但也有一些[具有挑战性的]时刻——10分钟的角球、界外球、角球、界外球。经历这些时刻并说，“保持冷静，伙计们，我们知道我们必须做什么，我们已经为此做好了准备，其他动力将会到来”，对我来说这是至关重要的。’不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限 - 立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Chelsea vs Tottenham: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 托特纳姆热刺：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: High-flying Chelsea return to the house of fun for a 5.30pm Saturday kick-off against Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League at Stamford Bridge. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton look ahead to derby day in west London. Over the coming weekends Chelsea host successive league games against traditional foes before the next international break and they do not come weightier than this cross-city clash of west and north. It is the Blues’ first game this season in a time-slot that has not recently been fruitful, with just seven points taken from the last possible 21 and a current run of two straight losses. However, we are undefeated in the past eight London derbies home and away played at this time, including a 1-0 defeat of our capital rivals in the reverse fixture last season. Roberto De Zerbi’s visitors were winless in all top-flight games this season until beating Frank Lampard’s Coventry City 3-1 at home on Monday, climbing out of the relegation zone as a result. Xabi Alonso’s Blues made what felt like a step forward with Saturday’s 2-0 victory at bogey side Everton and returned to the UEFA Champions League qualification places. Chelsea have taken the lead in six of our seven league outings to date – the complete opposite to Spurs – and have taken an average of just four minutes to open the scoring at the Bridge. Last May, the corresponding fixture ended 2-1 with Enzo Fernandez and Andrey Santos netting for the hosts to extend Spurs’ relegation reckoning to the final day. Chelsea have a remarkable home record against our second-oldest top-flight capital rivals and can make club history by beating the Cockerels an unprecedented seventh time in a row in the Premier League. Up to now, the Blues have beaten the Lilywhites 83 times across all competitions, more than any other opponent. Alonso confirmed in his pre-match press conference after Friday's training session that Malo Gusto was fit to return against Tottenham, having missed our win at Everton the previous weekend, but Pep Chavarria, Jamie Gittens and Emiliano Martinez remain unavailable. 'Malo is fine,' the Blues manager explained. 'Pep is training a little bit more, but he is not going to make it [for the Tottenham game]. 'Emi had the surgery and day-by-day he is feeling better, but we still need to wait. A few weeks. Hopefully, less than more, but we need to wait.' Emmanuel Emegha will also miss out. The striker has yet to feature since arriving this summer, but is making progress in his comeback. ‘He’s feeling better, but we need to wait,' said Alonso. Chelsea are undefeated in eight league derbies with this kick-off time, since Boxing Day 2020, winning seven, including at Tottenham a year ago at the Bridge through Joao Pedro’s stealthy finish. Down the Thames at Craven Cottage in mid-January 2021, Mason Mount settled the result late on, and some time after Antonee Robinson had been red carded. Four months later in the return against Fulham at the Bridge, Kai Havertz struck twice without reply to claim all the points in the west London derby. The German also drew early first blood at Crystal Palace in April, with Christian Pulisic quickly making it two inside 10 minutes. Kurt Zouma added a third for the visitors before Christian Benteke pulled one back for the shell-shocked hosts. Pulisic’s second made the last quarter-hour comfortable and it finished 4-1 to Chelsea. Two weeks later, at West Ham United’s London Stadium, Timo Werner netted the only goal of the game in the first half, Fabian Balbuema’s 81st-minute dismissal easing any nerves. At Brentford in October 2021, with fans back in the stadium, Ben Chilwell was the only name on the scoresheet, on the brink of half-time, with our only shot on target as Edouard Mendy kept the Bees at bay for Thomas Tuchel. A year ago at the Bridge, against this weekend’s visitors, with early fireworks fizzing the night sky, Moises Caicedo pounced on defensive uncertainty to set up Joao Pedro for the 1-0 winner. At the end of January 2026, Jarrod Bowen curled in West Ham’s opener in west London and Crysencio Summerville doubled their shock lead before the break. But Nuno Espírito Santo’s side were taken to task in the second half, with Joao Pedro’s close-range header halving the deficit before Marc Cucurella’s brave dive produced the leveller. Joao Pedro turned provider for Fernandez to drive in what proved the decisive finish, after which Anthony Taylor resolved a stoppage-time fracas with a red card for visiting defender Jean-Clair Todibo. Tottenham are Morgan Rogers’ favourite opponent, the Chelsea forward scoring a career-high four times against the Lilywhites. The Blues have won 55.7 per cent of ground duels – the most in this season’s top flight. Chelsea have now scored three goals in the opening minute of a half in the Premier League to date, our joint-most in a single campaign (alongside the entire 2011/12 season). Until last Saturday at Everton, Chelsea had not kept a clean sheet in the Premier League since the same 2-0 scoreline at home to Brentford on 17 January, 22 games ago. Pedro Neto had never previously scored twice in a Premier League game, though he had netted a hat-trick for the Blues against Hull City in the FA Cup. news.body_zh: 雄心勃勃的切尔西重返欢乐之家，参加周六下午 5 点 30 分在斯坦福桥举行的英超联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿展望伦敦西部的德比日。在接下来的周末，切尔西将在下一次国际比赛日之前连续对阵传统对手的联赛，他们的分量不会比这场西部和北部的跨城市冲突更重要。这是蓝军本赛季第一场比赛，在最近一段时间里并没有取得什么成果，在最后可能的21分中只拿下7分，并且目前已经连续两场失利。然而，我们在过去八场主客场伦敦德比中保持不败，包括上赛季在反向比赛中以 1-0 击败我们的首都对手。罗伯托·德泽尔比的客队本赛季在所有顶级联赛中均未尝一胜，直到周一主场3-1击败弗兰克·兰帕德的考文垂城，从而摆脱降级区。周六，哈维·阿隆索的蓝军以 2-0 战胜柏忌球队埃弗顿，感觉又向前迈进了一步，重返欧冠资格赛。迄今为止，切尔西在我们的七场联赛中有六场取得领先——这与热刺完全相反——并且平均只用了四分钟就在蓝桥首开纪录。去年5月，相应的比赛以2-1结束，恩佐·费尔南德斯和安德烈·桑托斯为东道主进球，将热刺的降级期延长到最后一天。切尔西在对阵我们第二古老的顶级联赛首都对手时拥有出色的主场战绩，并且可以在英超联赛中史无前例地连续第七次击败公鸡队，从而创造俱乐部历史。截至目前，蓝军在各项赛事中已经击败白百合队83次，超过任何其他对手。阿隆索在周五训练结束后的赛前新闻发布会上证实，马洛·古斯托在上周末错过了对阵埃弗顿的比赛后能够重返对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛，但佩普·查瓦里亚、杰米·吉滕斯和埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯仍然无法上场。 “马洛很好，”蓝军主帅解释道。 “佩普正在进行更多的训练，但他不会（参加托特纳姆热刺队的比赛）。 “艾米接受了手术，他感觉一天天好起来，但我们仍然需要等待。几个星期。希望是少而不是多，但我们需要等待。伊曼纽尔·埃梅加也将错过。自从今年夏天加盟以来，这位前锋还没有出场过，但他的复出正在取得进展。 “他感觉好多了，但我们需要等待，”阿隆索说。自 2020 年节礼日以来，切尔西在开赛期间在八场联赛德比中保持不败，赢得了七场胜利，其中包括一年前在蓝桥对阵托特纳姆热刺时凭借若奥·佩德罗的隐形进球。 2021 年 1 月中旬，在泰晤士河畔的克雷文小屋，梅森·芒特在晚些时候，也就是在安东尼·罗宾逊被红牌罚下一段时间后，确定了比赛结果。四个月后，在蓝桥对阵富勒姆的比赛中，凯·哈弗茨梅开二度，在西伦敦德比中全取积分。德国人还在四月份的水晶宫比赛中早早取得了首个进球，克里斯蒂安·普利西奇在 10 分钟内迅速梅开二度。库尔特·祖玛 (Kurt Zouma) 为客队攻入第三球，而克里斯蒂安·本特克 (Christian Benteke) 则为饱受炮弹袭击的东道主队扳回一球。普利西奇的第二个进球让比赛最后一刻变得轻松，最终切尔西 4-1 获胜。两周后，在西汉姆联队的伦敦体育场，蒂莫·维尔纳在上半场打进了比赛的唯一进球，法比安·巴尔布埃马在第 81 分钟的下场缓解了紧张情绪。 2021 年 10 月在布伦特福德，球迷们回到了球场，本·奇尔韦尔是进球表上唯一的名字，在半场结束前，爱德华·门迪为托马斯·图赫尔挡住了蜜蜂队，这是我们唯一的射门。一年前，在蓝桥对阵本周末的客队时，夜空中早早燃放烟花，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多抓住了防守的不确定性，助攻若昂·佩德罗以 1-0 获胜。 2026 年 1 月下旬，贾罗德·鲍文 (Jarrod Bowen) 在西汉姆联队在伦敦西部的揭幕战中打进一球，克里森西奥·萨默维尔 (Crysencio Summerville) 在中场休息前将领先优势扩大了一倍。但努诺·圣埃斯皮里托·桑托的球队在下半场遇到了麻烦，若昂·佩德罗的近距离头球将比分差距减半，随后马克·库库雷拉的勇敢跳水将比分扳平。 若昂·佩德罗为费尔南德斯提供了帮助，最终完成了决定性的进球，随后安东尼·泰勒为客队后卫让·克莱尔·托迪博出示红牌，化解了伤停补时阶段的争吵。托特纳姆热刺是摩根·罗杰斯最喜欢的对手，这位切尔西前锋在对阵白百合队的比赛中四次得分创职业生涯新高。蓝军在地面对决中获胜率为 55.7%，是本赛季顶级联赛中获胜率最高的。迄今为止，切尔西在英超联赛中在半场开场一分钟就打进了三个进球，这是我们单赛季进球最多的球队（以及整个 2011/12 赛季）。直到上周六客场对阵埃弗顿之前，切尔西自22场比赛前1月17日主场2-0布伦特福德以来在英超联赛中还没有保持过零失球。佩德罗·内托此前从未在英超比赛中梅开二度，尽管他在足总杯对阵赫尔城的比赛中为蓝军上演了帽子戏法。不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限 - 立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Loan switch for Shaun Wade
news.title_zh: 肖恩·韦德的租借转换
news.body_en: Chelsea Academy winger Shaun Wade has completed a loan move to Dulwich Hamlet. Wade has represented Chelsea in the Under-18s and Cobham Next Gen and will now continue his development in south London. Dulwich play in the Isthmian Premier Division, with Wade set to join his Blues team-mate Hudson Sands there. We wish Shaun well and look forward to monitoring his development at Dulwich.
news.body_zh: 切尔西青训边锋肖恩·韦德已完成租借至德威哈姆雷特。韦德曾代表切尔西参加 18 岁以下青年队和科巴姆下一代队，现在将在伦敦南部继续他的发展。德威队效力于伊斯米亚超级联赛，韦德将与他的蓝军队友哈德逊金沙队一起在那里踢球。我们祝愿肖恩一切顺利，并期待关注他在德威的发展。

news.title: Lacroix shares his journey from village life to the bright lights of the Bridge
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦分享了他从乡村生活到桥上明亮灯光的旅程
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix discusses his untypical footballing origins, in a farming village in the Dordogne region, and reveals his cultural hinterland in a wide-ranging interview for the matchday programme for Saturday’s Premier League game against Tottenham Hotspur. The France international defender grew up as one of a handful of kids playing football in the surrounding villages, where his parents both worked in the medical profession, and has risen to become a serial winner. 'It’s a farming village and there were maybe 300 people, with maybe five young children, because there were a lot of older people, or people who worked on the farms. My mother is a doctor, a general practitioner. And my father, he is working as a resuscitation nurse in the hospital. 'When I was young, I was quite close to wanting to be a vet, because animals were always close to me, you know. 'I started playing football at four. I was a goalkeeper, because my father was a goalkeeper. He put me on the field, because he loved football – he still does – and he said to me: "Okay, now it’s the time for you to start playing too".' The rest, as they say, is history, and now the 26-year-old is enjoying a year to remember, having gone to the FIFA World Cup off the back of a UEFA Conference League triumph with his former club Crystal Palace, then returned to London to begin the next chapter of his career with Chelsea. 'It’s going good,' he says of the season so far. 'I think we are in a better way, and you know, it was really quick for me, because I just left the national team, I had just a little bit of holidays and then I came back directly to playing the first game. So no, it was strange, but now I feel really settled in the team, so this is really good for me. 'It is fun, and it is a big team, you know – the players here are the best in the league. So I’m really happy to represent the badge and to be part of this big journey.' Elsewhere in the programme, club historian Rick Glanvill reflects on the impact Matthew Harding made on the club, as we mark the 30th anniversary of his tragic death in a helicopter crash on the way back from an away game at Bolton Wanderers in October 1996. The team that Harding’s investment helped to build went on to become one of the most cherished in Chelsea history, and their 6-1 win at White Hart Lane in December 1997 is the focus of our Greatest Games feature. Then there is all the info you need on the game ahead, plus the latest from around the club, including columns from Xabi Alonso and Reece James. So be sure to pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge or order online from our publications partner, Reach Sport.
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 在周六英超联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛日节目中接受了广泛的采访，讨论了他在多尔多涅地区的一个农村的非典型足球起源，并透露了他的文化腹地。这位法国国脚后卫是周围村庄里少数几个踢足球的孩子之一，他的父母都在当地从事医疗行业，并已成为连续的胜利者。 “这是一个农庄，大约有 300 人，可能有 5 个小孩，因为有很多老年人，或者在农场工作的人。我的母亲是一名医生，一名全科医生。我的父亲在医院担任复苏护士。 “当我年轻的时候，我非常想成为一名兽医，因为动物总是离我很近，你知道。 “我四岁开始踢足球。我是一名守门员，因为我父亲是一名守门员。他让我上场，因为他热爱足球——他仍然如此——他对我说：“好吧，现在你也开始踢球了”。正如他们所说，剩下的都是历史了，现在这位 26 岁的球员正在享受令人难忘的一年，他在欧洲足联会议联赛中与他的前俱乐部水晶宫取得胜利后前往国际足联世界杯，然后返回伦敦，在切尔西开始了他职业生涯的下一个篇章。 “进展顺利，”他谈到本赛季到目前为止的情况时说道。 “我认为我们处于更好的状态，你知道，这对我来说真的很快，因为我刚刚离开国家队，我只有一点假期，然后我就直接回来参加第一场比赛。所以不，这很奇怪，但现在我感觉自己真正融入了球队，所以这对我来说真的很好。 “这很有趣，而且这是一支大球队，你知道——这里的球员是联盟中最好的。所以我真的很高兴能够代表徽章并成为这一伟大旅程的一部分。”在节目的其他地方，俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔反思了马修·哈丁对俱乐部的影响，我们正在纪念他在 1996 年 10 月客场对阵博尔顿队的比赛回来途中因直升机失事不幸身亡 30 周年。哈丁投资帮助建立的球队后来成为切尔西历史上最珍贵的球队之一，他们 1997 年 12 月在白鹿巷球场 6-1 的胜利是我们的焦点最伟大的游戏功能。然后是您需要的有关即将到来的比赛的所有信息，以及俱乐部的最新信息，包括 Xabi Alonso 和 Reece James 的专栏。因此，请务必从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处获取您的副本，或从我们的出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。
